name: Southern Company

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Southern Company logo new.svg)

description: Southern Company is a utility holding company. Its three state-regulated electric utilities (Georgia Power, Alabama Power, Mississippi Power) serve most of the Southeast, Southern Company Gas distributes natural gas to about 4.4 million customers in Illinois, Georgia, Virginia and Tennessee, and Southern Power sells electricity wholesale from mostly renewable plants; the system serves about 9.0 million electric and gas utility customers. The regulated utilities earn an allowed return on the plants and grid they build: for example Georgia Power's retail ROE set point is 10.50% on a 56% equity ratio, and Nicor Gas (Illinois) got 9.60% on 50% equity in a rate increase effective December 2, 2025. Growth comes from investing in new generation and grid for data centers and other large loads (the Georgia PSC has certified about 13 GW of resources) and from getting those investments approved for recovery.

That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. Note the box hides that about 17 percent of revenue is natural gas distribution (Southern Company Gas). SEC SIC code 4911 (Electric Services) per EDGAR.

businessLines.name: Traditional electric operating companies (Georgia Power, Alabama Power, Mississippi Power)
businessLines.how: Customers pay regulated retail rates monthly; regulators let each utility recover costs (fuel passes through) and earn an allowed return on equity on the plant and grid it owns (Georgia Power 10.50% set point on 56% equity), so profit rises as new generation, transmission and grid spending is added and approved; large industrial and data-center customers add load and revenue.
businessLines.description: State-regulated vertically integrated electric utilities in Georgia, Alabama and Mississippi; territory of about 116,000 square miles and 17 million people.

businessLines.name: Southern Company Gas
businessLines.how: Customers pay regulated delivery rates each month for gas; the utility earns an allowed return on the pipe it owns (Nicor Gas 9.60% on 50% equity) and passes through the cost of the gas itself; cold weather raises volumes.
businessLines.description: Natural gas distribution (Nicor Gas in Illinois, plus utilities in Georgia, Virginia and Tennessee; about 4.4 million customers) and complementary businesses such as pipeline and storage investments.

operatingProfit.note: Segment net income; FY2024 $740M; includes a $63M pre-tax ($47M after tax) Nicor Gas capital-investment disallowance

businessLines.name: Southern Power
businessLines.how: Sells wholesale electricity at market-based rates to utilities and other load-serving buyers (per the 10-K); revenue depends on plant output and the prices its counterparties pay, and it carries no regulated rate base.
businessLines.description: Wholesale electric generation, mostly renewables, sold in competitive markets to investor-owned utilities, independent power producers, municipalities and other load-serving entities.
